# ai commands

Every `ai` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `ai:ask`

Agent-facing introspection aggregator (capabilities, mechanisms, project, module, route, event, path, logs)

```bash
bin/semitexa ai:ask ["subject"]
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--name` | yes |
| `--path` | yes |
| `--method` | yes |
| `--file` | yes |
| `--lines` | yes |
| `--grep` | yes |
| `--level` | yes |
| `--since` | yes |
| `--around` | yes |
| `--context` | yes |
| `--list` | no |
| `--id` | yes |
| `--area` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `ai:backlog`

Backlog hygiene: stats + cleanup proposals (dry-run; --apply to commit)

```bash

```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--apply` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `ai:invoke`

Dry-run a payload handler from CLI — skip HTTP/auth/middleware. Use for fast feedback on changes.

```bash
bin/semitexa ai:invoke
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--route` | yes |
| `--method` | yes |
| `--handler` | yes |
| `--payload` | yes |
| `--json` | no |
| `--human` | no |

## `ai:observe`

Observatory for agents: ps (live snapshot) | tail (journal rows, --follow streams) | show --id (one process + its trace)


| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--id` | yes |
| `--mutate` | yes |
| `--kind` | yes |
| `--name` | yes |
| `--lines` | yes |
| `--follow` | no |
| `--duration` | yes |
| `--source` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `ai:orient`

Session dashboard: git + active epic + in-progress tasks + recent traces + next step. Run this first on a cold start.

```bash
bin/semitexa ai:orient
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |
| `--human` | no |
| `--traces` | yes |
